scope: Trained event models and a common continuing decision controller; not an end-to-end SNN superiority experiment.
truth_design: Equal eventual hit probability, different physical clocks: mu, sigma squared, and cancel rate all scale by two.
observation_contract: Every WAIT explicitly starts a new independent reset contract. Observe an exact hit time if hit precedes hidden cancellation and horizon; otherwise observe no_hit at the horizon. no_hit includes hidden cancellation and is not pure survival. Latent cancellation times are never policy inputs.
context_contract: All models receive the same noisy scalar class context, with the same known likelihood; it is not an extra trained parameter or privileged state.
controller: Shared one-step expected terminal utility lookahead, followed by replanning. STOP predicts the current posterior mode. WAIT values include query, expected elapsed-time, and observed-hit costs. It is not an exact globally optimal controller.
quadrature: Gauss-Legendre event-time quadrature, with each class's nonnegative event masses normalized to its analytical finite-horizon hit probability. Report pre-normalization mass residuals and count table construction.
fit_selection: Three preregistered starts for every class and family; choose smallest training likelihood loss. Development data do not select architecture, costs, starts, or controller thresholds.
primary_metric: Net terminal classification utility including query, actual elapsed-time and observed-hit costs.
uncertainty: Paired differences within the same latent episode bank; report per-training-seed means and a t interval across five independent training seeds. Episode count is not the number of independent training replications. Use simultaneous Bonferroni intervals for the two primary contrasts.
comparison_budget: Identical six parameters, records, visible information, three starts and maximum optimizer iterations. Actual compute differs and is reported; no equal-wall-time or hardware-energy claim.
confirmation_rule: Confirmation and OOD generation require an explicit git freeze commit containing byte-identical critical source files and the complete trained bundle. Any subsequent source/model change requires a new protocol and fresh confirmation seeds.
claims_not_resolved: universal identifiability with unknown voltage scale
